recommendation.text: The Board recommends that, for large procurement actions, the Administration further strengthen procurement record management to clearly distinguish between new procurement actions, contract amendments and assessments of material changes, so that the rationale for the procurement approach and contract amendment adopted is clearly documented and compliance with the United Nations Procurement Manual and the delegation of procurement authority framework can be readily demonstrated.
